distinct_generations.note: Repeated cached control summaries are appearances of one learned checkpoint, not independent runs or new teachers. Missing hashes are unknown, not assumed unique.

hypothesis_decisions.decision: not supported as a sufficient remedy
hypothesis_decisions.limitation: This does not prove volume is irrelevant; sources, selectors and tested teacher budgets delimit the result.

hypothesis_decisions.decision: learning benefits are real but do not meet Base criteria
hypothesis_decisions.limitation: No automatic extension or claim that an untested longer run must work. Existing2B-to5B completion may be linked separately; not newly measured here.

hypothesis_decisions.decision: preselected earliest saved8.15M does not rescue quality
hypothesis_decisions.limitation: One nested trajectory; no further checkpoint selection by quality.

hypothesis_decisions.hypothesis: Higher historical parent Web quality solves free generation
hypothesis_decisions.decision: historical route rejected despite passing Web guard
hypothesis_decisions.limitation: Parent model/Adam/RNG/scheduler/actualLR/cursor differ together; not isolated LR causality.

hypothesis_decisions.hypothesis: Balancing longest/shortest training queries rescues transfer and free text
hypothesis_decisions.decision: predefined intervention failed both main and secondary screens

hypothesis_decisions.limitation: Local assay is not proof of no conflict in all training.

hypothesis_decisions.hypothesis: Two tested10M shapes or source replacements settle capacity
hypothesis_decisions.decision: comparisons failed; capacity ceiling remains unproved
hypothesis_decisions.limitation: Small source,300M teachers and tested architectures do not cover all10M training strategies.

hypothesis_decisions.hypothesis: Good train fit/local structured scores establish Japanese Base quality
hypothesis_decisions.limitation: Shared-generator local probes are distinct from free-text consistency and protected test.

conclusions: No cited candidate is an adopted Base. Web BPB, EOS count and local structured transfer are insufficient quality proxies.
Larger material and teacher budgets sometimes help but neither guarantees grammar/coherence. Historical parent route failed; do not repeat it.
The remaining issue is generalization of coherent natural short prose while preserving Web quality; the completed interventions mostly adjust existing mixtures/templates or parent states.
A materially different data/objective route needs an explicit novelty and feasibility check before any additional GPU training. A new arbitrary ratio/LR/template or longer-run sweep is unjustified.
next_decision: Do not start GPU from this synthesis alone. Check whether a train-only, public-license, substantially diverse natural Japanese prose distillation/source route has already been tried and is feasible locally; define one finite controlled comparison only if it is new and meets source quality/retention constraints.
limitations: Repeated fixeddev and nonblind one learned seed do not establish independent natural-text generalization or sole causes. Better BPB/local structural scores are not Base completion.
